item.title: Suspect Arrested by Warrant for Burglaries in Greenwich and New Canaan

item.title: Board of Selectmen Approves $186.9 Million Budget
item.description: The first of New Canaan government’s three funding bodies voted unanimously last week in favor of a spending plan for the town for next fiscal year.
